notes.purpose: Hay bales on posts and a hay stack inside a fenced cobble pen read as much as an animal pen as a drill yard; nothing says archery or weapons yet.
notes.detail: Torches on the corner posts, a bench and two storage blocks; the floor is a busy gravel/coarse-dirt patchwork.
notes.roof: A yard, no roof: judged on the post tops (torches on logs).
notes.life: Moss on the curb, torches; no plants.

visual.summary: Fenced, raised gravel drill yard with spruce corner posts, two hay-bale dummies, hay butts at the back and a bench and store by the entrance.
problems: Does not read as a training yard yet: give at least one dummy fence arms (x=1/x=3 at y=2 beside the dummy at x=2, z=3) or put a weapon rack/chest marker by the entrance so L1 says 'military', not 'pen'.
Floor patchwork of coarse dirt (y=0) is noisy; group it into a worn path along the dummies and the archery lane instead of scattered patches.
Reach: whole yard floor reached; only the post tops and hay dummy top are unreached (fine).
